Client reports — verified

Dated entries from homeowners in Madison and nearby towns.

  • Open-book budgets Erik J., Middleton
    Ingrid sent us the full cost sheet for our basement: framing, electrical, HVAC, drywall, flooring, her fee and a 10% contingency. We used about half of the contingency and she showed us exactly where it went. Final number came in 3% over the starting budget.
    Sample review
  • Egress windows Hannah V., Sun Prairie
    We wanted a guest bedroom in the basement and learned it needed an egress window to count. They cut the foundation, set the well with a drain and the room passed inspection the first time.
    Sample review
  • Bathroom remodels Marcus O., Madison
    Every allowance had a number next to it: tile, faucets, lighting. When we picked a more expensive tile, the change order showed the difference to the dollar before they ordered it.
    Sample review
  • Older-home updates Clare P., Madison
    Our 1915 house on the east side had knob-and-tube wiring hidden in one wall. They found it during the walk-through, priced it before demo, and it was in the budget from day one instead of a surprise.
    Sample review
